let inOrder = async (items, step, {reason}) => {
 for (const item of items) { await step(item); }
};
inOrder(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
async function inOrderSteps(steps) {
 for (const step of steps) {

  await step();
 }
}
// ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
inOrderSteps(steps);
var inOrderSteps = async (steps, {reason}) => {
 for (const step of steps) { await step(); }
};
inOrderSteps([step], {reason: "Each stage reads the previous stage output"});
